name: Inaugural IZA@LISER Conference in Labour Economics
organizer: IZA Network at LISER (Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research)
venue: Abbaye de Neumünster, 28 Rue Münster, Grund
submission_requirements: Full paper (preferred) or extended abstract of at least 1,500 words, in PDF, via the conference submission website. Topics: labour economics, education, family and gender economics, inequality, innovation, migration, political economy of labour-market institutions
registration_fee: None (no conference fee; participants arrange their own travel and accommodation funding)
keynotes: Patricia Cortés (Boston University); Benjamin Schoefer (UC Berkeley); special guest Daniel Hamermesh (UT Austin)
